qconfig_repr: QConfig(activation=functools.partial(<class 'torch.ao.quantization.fake_quantize.FusedMovingAvgObsFakeQuantize'>, observer=<class 'torch.ao.quantization.observer.MovingAverageMinMaxObserver'>, quant_min=0, quant_max=255, reduce_range=True){}, weight=functools.partial(<class 'torch.ao.quantization.fake_quantize.FusedMovingAvgObsFakeQuantize'>, observer=<class 'torch.ao.quantization.observer.MovingAveragePerChannelMinMaxObserver'>, quant_min=-128, quant_max=127, dtype=torch.qint8, qscheme=torch.per_channel_symmetric){})
observer_init: 1,000 stratified training images (seed 42, same as the static PTQ calibration); the activation and per-channel weight ranges of a static PTQ calibration on those images are copied into the QAT observers, so epoch 0 = static PTQ (checked)
loss: CrossEntropyLoss, class weights 'balanced' from the training split

schedule.adaptation: epochs 1-2: fake quant on, observers updating, BN updating, lr 1e-05 constant
schedule.fine-tuning: epochs 3-7: cosine lr decay from 1e-05, observers and BN updating
schedule.stabilization: epochs 8-10: BN statistics frozen (after epoch 7), observers disabled (scales/zero points fixed), weights keep training, lr continues the cosine toward 0

saved_model: final model (epoch 10); validation only monitored, no epoch selection; test never used
